panels.title: Version
panels.description: The server's version, the radio's variant (hf, vhf) and its RX channels (ddc, bins).

panels.title: Audio lost (1 h)
panels.description: RX blocks the DSP workers lost and audio frames dropped to slow clients, last hour.

panels.title: Channels leased by class
panels.description: RX channels held per lease class; 'waiting': requests queued for a channel.

panels.title: Frames dropped to clients
panels.description: Frames a client didn't take in time (its link too slow).

panels.title: Worker load
panels.description: Busy share of each DSP worker (1 = its core).

panels.title: Worker time by job kind
panels.description: Estimated from every 8th round; the stack is about the worker's load.

panels.title: Shed level
panels.description: 0: none. Raised when a worker is behind; waterfalls get cheaper, audio never.

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Most RX blocks (~5 ms each) waiting in the last second; above 32 sheds load.

panels.title: Blocks lost
panels.description: RX blocks lost break audio; WF blocks lost cost waterfall lines.

panels.title: Views by span
panels.description: decim: the ADC rate over the span's (higher: more zoomed in).

panels.title: Decoder CPU by band
panels.description: Decoder CPU per band, in cores (2 on the Web-888).

panels.title: Slots not decoded in full (1 h)
panels.description: Cut short, shed or dropped, as a share of the band's slots, over the last hour.

targets.expr: sum by (band, mode) (increase(web888d_skim_slots_cut_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h]) + increase(web888d_skim_slots_shed_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h]) + increase(web888d_skim_slots_dropped_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h])) / clamp_min(sum by (band, mode) (increase(web888d_skim_slots_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h]) + increase(web888d_skim_slots_shed_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h])), 1)

panels.title: Log sinks
panels.description: Only the sinks with a server set; gpsd when configured.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of all cores: the whole system, each DSP worker, the skimmers' decoders.

panels.title: Top threads
panels.description: CPU per thread name, in cores.

panels.title: File systems used
panels.description: /tmp is in RAM on the Web-888.

panels.title: Radio
panels.description: clock ppm is 0 without a GPS PPS.
